title: INMA customer.selection_changed Webhook Contract (FEAT-INMA-PIPELINE-V2 C2-C4) — FINAL
description: INMA-authoritative customer_status akisi (Q karari 2026-05-12). v2.0 = INMA'nin RESMI CEVABINA gore nihai kontrat (cevap: arch/reports/20260610-inma-customer-status-webhook-cevap.md). Bizim v1.1 teklifimiz (PascalCase, mesaj/ack borusuna yeni shape) INMA gercekligiyle DEGISTI: event ZATEN CANLI olan ayri sistem-olaylari webhook altyapisindan gelir (transactional outbox + HMAC-SHA256 imza + retry). INMA 2026-06-10'da teklifimizdeki eksikleri AYNI GUN ekledi: data.phone/phones, data.originRequestId echo (update'e ClientRequestID), text-modu eventleri. ChangeVersion YOK (Faz 2; fallback recetesi asagida). INMA tarafinda BACKEND GELISTIRMESI GEREKMIYOR — is tamamen bizde: abonelik (KURULDU 2026-06-10 15:45, MSSQL CompanyWebhookEndpoints ID=1 dogrulandi) + consumer implementasyonu (C2).
status: FINAL (INMA cevabi 2026-06-10; abonelik canli — endpoint Url=https://services.invekto.com/api/v1/webhook/event?companyId=5050, EventType=customer.selection_changed Enabled)

delivery_channel.infrastructure: INMA sistem-olaylari webhook'u — mesaj/ack push borusundan AYRI altyapi (transactional outbox: durum degisikligiyle ayni DB tx'inde kuyruga yazilir, 'degisiklik oldu ama event uretilmedi' olamaz).
delivery_channel.subscription: Invekto panelinden bir kerelik kurulum: URL + secret + event aboneligi. Secret kurulumda BIR KEZ gorunur. 5050 icin KURULDU (2026-06-10 15:45). MSSQL dogrulama: CompanyWebhookEndpoints(CompanyID=11, Url=bizim endpoint, Enabled, TimeoutSeconds=30, SchemaVersion=1) + CompanyWebhookEndpointEvents(EventType='customer.selection_changed', Enabled). NOT: ayni Url mesaj/ack push'lari icin de gecerli (ayni tablo) — bu yonlendirmeyle 5050 delivery-ack loop'u da ACILDI.
delivery_channel.auth: HMAC-SHA256 imza: X-Invekto-Signature header (imza kapsami 'timestamp.body') + X-Invekto-Event-Id / X-Invekto-Event-Type / X-Invekto-Timestamp header'lari. Dogrulama kod ornekleri 'Invekto Webhook Musteri Rehberi' PDF'inde (C#/PHP/Python/Node/Java). KURAL: imzasiz/dogrulanmamis istek ISLENMEZ (C2 implementasyon sarti). Secret'in bizim tarafta saklanma yeri C2 interview konusu (tenant settings_json onerisi).
delivery_channel.retry_policy: At-least-once. Gecici hatalarda (5xx/408/429/timeout/DNS) exponential backoff: anlik → +1dk → +5dk → +15dk → +1sa → +6sa (6 deneme, ~7.5 saat); sonrasi kalici 'failed' (admin yeniden kuyruklayabilir). 3xx ve diger 4xx KALICI FAIL (retry yok), 401 max 3 deneme. URL bazli circuit breaker: ardisik 10 fail → 5dk-1sa soguma. Retry'da SAKLANAN GOVDE byte'i byte'ina yeniden gonderilir (id sabit).
delivery_channel.response_contract: 2xx = kabul (dedupe bizde). Kalici kaydedemezsek 5xx → INMA retry. UYARI: handler'imizda EventType dali yokken bu eventler 400 alir = INMA tarafinda KALICI FAIL → C2 implementasyonu zaman-duyarli.

customer_selection_changed_event.idempotency: data dedupe anahtari = 'id' (UUID, retry'da sabit; X-Invekto-Event-Id header'inda da var). INSE dedupe: UNIQUE(tenant_id, event_id), saklama 30 gun.

feature_groups_catalog.consumer_use: Flow Builder durum dropdown'u: Backend proxy + cache. Catalog-degisiklik event'i YOK (INMA cevabi soru 9) → periyodik refresh (gunluk + akis editoru acilisinda). featureGroupId/featureIds STABIL; isimler event uretim aninda cozulur → trigger eslesmesi ID ile.

customer_selections_read.consumer_use: Sira-disilik/kacak tespitinde otoriter durum cekimi (fallback recetesi adim c) + telefon eslesmeyince customerId ile dogrulama.

set_customer_status_action.owner: INMA (MEVCUT — PDF SS6.3 + YENI: ClientRequestID alani 2026-06-10)
set_customer_status_action.consumer_use: C4 'Set Customer Status' action: {CustomerID|Phone, FeatureGroupID, FeatureIDs[], ClientRequestID?} — full-list semantics, atomik + audit Source='api'. ClientRequestID (string, max 128) event'te data.originRequestId olarak AYNEN doner. Hata: 920/921/922/923; lookup CustomerID oncelikli, Phone fallback, ikisi bos 401, musteri yok 903.
set_customer_status_action.loop_guard: BIRINCIL: ClientRequestID='invekto-{flowRunUuid}' gonder → event'te originRequestId eslesirse trigger SUPPRESS. IKINCI GUVENCE (INMA-side, zaten canli): natural idempotency — ayni nihai kumeyle update NO-OP'tur, event uretmez → sonsuz dongu zaten imkansiz. UCUNCU: actor.type=='api' icin tenant-config varsayilan suppress (diger API istemcileri icin; acilabilir).

ordering_fallback_recipe.source: INMA cevabi soru 2 (ChangeVersion YOK — Faz 2 adayi; canlida sira-disilik frekansi yuksek cikarsa additive sayac eklenir, sema kirilmaz)
steps: (a) occurredAt guard: customerId+featureGroupId basina son uygulanan occurredAt'i sakla; eski/esit olani atla.
(b) zincir kontrolu: sira dogruysa her event'in 'before'u elimizdeki guncel duruma esittir; degilse sira-disilik/kacak var.
(c) zincir kirildiysa customer-selections'tan otoriter durumu cek (fetch-verify), store'u ona cek; trigger'i payload yerine otoriter duruma gore degerlendir.

inse_side_implementation_notes.c2_ingress: Backend webhook handler'a 'type' dali (mesaj/ack kontrollerinden ONCE): HMAC dogrulama (X-Invekto-Signature, 'timestamp.body', secret tenant-scoped) → ZORUNLU; imzasiz istek ISLENMEZ → companyId tenant cozumu (query-string; govde companyId cross-check audit'e) → DURABLE raw-event yazimi → 2xx; persist FAIL → 5xx. Async: dedupe(tenant_id, id, 30g) → ordering_fallback_recipe → opaque store → Automation flow-trigger forward. NOT: dal yokken eventler 400 = INMA'da KALICI fail → oncelikli implement.
inse_side_implementation_notes.c2_secret: Abonelik secret'i INMA panel kurulumunda bir kez gorunur; INMA MSSQL CompanyWebhookEndpoints.Secret'ta da durur (readonly erisimimiz var) ama dogru yol: Q panel'den alir → tenant settings_json'a (alan adi C2 interview).
inse_side_implementation_notes.c2_phone_matching: phones[] icinde tenant-scoped leads.phone ara (kendi numarayi da rakama indir). Ulke kodu garantisi YOK → eslesmezse customerId ile customer-selections dogrulamasi; yine yoksa drop-with-audit + WARN (lead-create YOK).
inse_side_implementation_notes.c2_storage: leads.customer_status TEXT (opaque). Derivasyon: single → after.featureNames[0]; [] → NULL; multi → featureNames alfabetik CSV; text → after.textValue (alan yoksa NULL). Ham event audit tablosuna featureIds ile (rename guvenligi). pipeline_status VARCHAR(30) kaderi C2 migration interview'unda.
inse_side_implementation_notes.c3_trigger: FlowGraphV2.TriggerTypes += 'customer_status_changed' + INodeHandler + DI. trigger_config eslesmesi featureGroupId + opsiyonel from/to featureId (isim DEGIL). Suppress sirasi: originRequestId eslesmesi → actor.type=='api' tenant-config varsayilan suppress (acilabilir) → actor.type=='zoho-webhook' tenant-config (varsayilan suppress onerisi). Flow context: {{customer_status_group}}, {{old_customer_status}}, {{new_customer_status}}, {{customer_status_changed_by}}.
inse_side_implementation_notes.c4_action: ActionSetCustomerStatusHandler → update endpoint'i + ClientRequestID='invekto-{flowRunUuid}' + flow-run-uuid suppress-tablosu (TTL ~1h). INMA natural idempotency (ayni kume no-op, event yok) ikinci guvence. Dropdown: catalog proxy + cache (gunluk refresh + editor acilisinda).
